recipientReview: Personal wallet handles supporter tokens; Agency wallet controls ENS subnames only. Refresh ENS resolution and Base role/recipient state before any signature. No mint, transfer, royalty configuration or admin grant has executed.

primarySalesRouting.note: Existing escrow retains proceeds. Personal minting does not itself authorize a stock transfer or primary-sales rerouting.

nftAdminPlan.note: Keep the existing personal NFT admin. Do not sign the superseded Agency grant.

publicationGate: Only publish after source, artifacts, recipient and applicable release acceptance are verified. Wallet signatures remain paused.
authorization: Preparation only. Separate explicit steward signatures are required for any register, mint, transfer or listing.
